name: Hermitage
description: Hermitage is a modern Navidrome/OpenSubsonic web client with immersive Now Playing, synced lyrics, live spectrum visualisation, artwork-driven themes, queue and playlist management, responsive ultrawide layouts, PWA support and a desktop-first library interface.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent encrypted sessions and Hermitage server data.

variables.name: Navidrome URL
variables.description: Navidrome/OpenSubsonic base URL as reachable from this container.

variables.name: Lock Navidrome URL
variables.description: Hide server selection from the login screen and force the configured Navidrome URL.

variables.name: Allowed Navidrome Hosts
variables.description: Optional comma-separated hostname/IP allow-list. Do not include ports.

variables.name: Secure Cookies
variables.description: Set true only when Hermitage is accessed exclusively over HTTPS.

variables.name: Persistent Artwork Cache Items
variables.description: Maximum persistent artwork renditions retained under /data/cover-cache.

variables.name: Login Rate Limit
variables.description: Failed login attempts allowed per client IP in five minutes.

variables.name: Trust Proxy
variables.description: Express trust-proxy value. 1 is suitable when one reverse proxy sits in front of Hermitage.
